inputs.proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2
inputs.original_proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2

blockers: Data race on non-atomic m_currentFrameCount: in app/qttunebridge.cpp line 148, onFrame() (worker thread) reads m_currentFrameCount without synchronization, while handleFrameInternal() (GUI thread) increments it. m_currentFrameCount is declared as 'int m_currentFrameCount = 0;' (non-atomic) in app/qttunebridge.h line 117.
questions: What is the intended semantics of the backpressure check? The old code used m_inFlightFrames (atomic queue depth) to bound queued work, while the new code checks m_currentFrameCount (model size) which creates a race and may be redundant since the model already evicts old frames.
Why were the SignalListModel and signal batching tests removed? Is this intentional feature removal or an incomplete refactoring?
The forceFrameCountForTesting method is removed - how are frame boundary tests supposed to work now?
nits: In app/qttunebridge.cpp line 47, m_frames.erase(m_frames.begin()) in appendFrame() is O(n) - consider using a circular buffer or deque if performance matters at 10k frames.
The removed code had proper null checks with early returns on lines 22-23 of the original - the new code uses more verbose if statements but achieves the same result.
